Tower: round warm-grey limestone drum,6.4 metres in diameter,12 metres tall before roof, plus a simple conical dark slate-red (#6B2F28) tiled roof with a small aged-brass (#B8923A) finial. A continuous circular ring of simple large stone battlements surrounds the foot of the cone. Two narrow arrow slits TOTAL in the entire tower: both centered on this front face, one above the other at different heights. Remaining left/back/right faces unpierced, otherwise rotationally identical shape. No door, stairs, flags, towers attached, window glass, ornament, spikes or base terrain. Broad clean limestone blocks, restrained mortar, lightly worn edges, tiny amount moss low down, few chips, no tiny cracks or noisy textures. Dark oak only where structurally necessary. Quiet lower contrast than hero.
Camera exact FRONT elevation, zero yaw, horizontal orthographic-style view, no dramatic top view. Whole tower centered on square canvas, top finial at8% height, baseline92%; generous margin on all sides. Body diameter roughly40% of canvas, roof slightly wider; realistic tall tower proportions. Square PNG1254x1254 or larger. Plain #E6E6E6 light grey background, even soft light, NO ground/contact/cast shadow, no floor, no scene, no text/labels, no people or characters. ONE view only.
